text:
rachel: Quick heads-up — v1.12 cutoff is 3:00pm PT today. We need docs staging deploy + SDK docs regen landed before then. Who can own deploy and smoke? :hourglass: 

mike: I can do the staging deploy, but I need all changelog bumps merged by 2:15pm PT.

anya (devex): I’ll run the SDK regen after changelog is merged. Plan: regen -> publish artifacts -> docs build. Can someone confirm the artifact path we should point release notes at?

ben: Artifact path will be `s3://redwood-artifacts/releases/v1.12/sdk/*`. I’ll add the changelog blurb for my CLI bump now.

maria (product): I can review the changelog wording for API surface changes — will do a quick pass by 1:45pm.

sam: heads-up: small breaking change for the console plugin (version bump). I opened PR #8921 — needs a quick CR/merge so docs examples don't break.

rachel: pinging @ben @mike for PR #8921 — if we can merge before 2:00, mike can include it in the staging build.

ben: on it, giving it one last run of tests. If green I'll merge in ~10m.

anya (devex): regeneration checklist (copying here):
```
1) merge changelog PRs
2) run `./scripts/regen-sdk.sh` on staging
3) publish sdk artifacts to staging S3
4) kick docs build: `./infra/deploy_docs.sh --staging`
5) run `npm run smoke:docs` (sampling routes)
6) confirm redirects + snippet examples
```

mike: good checklist. Also: please confirm the docs build image tag — use `docs-builder:2026-03-16` (we patched a favicon issue).

ben: tests passed, merging #8921 now.

docs-bot: staging deploy queued for run-id 20260316-74 (owner: mike).

maria (product): quick note on changelog: reworded the plugin change to be less scary, added migration snippet. LMK if ok.

sam: reviewed, looks good to me. :thumbsup:

anya (devex): regen started. Will post artifact links when done.

mike: starting staging deploy (watching logs). If anything fails we rollback to tag v1.11.5 — hold window til 4:00pm PT.

docs-bot: staging deploy succeeded (run-id 20260316-74). URL: https://staging-docs.internal.redwood.ai/v1.12

anya (devex): SDK artifacts published: s3://redwood-artifacts/releases/v1.12/sdk/{js,py,go}. Happy path smoke started.

mike: smoke checks: samples OK, search index updated, redirects look fine. I’m going to promote to canary at 3:20pm unless anyone objects.

rachel: no objections from me. Thanks everyone — I’ll assemble release notes once the canary is stable and the SDK artifacts are in the release bucket. If anything flaps, post here and we’ll roll back. :rocket:
